title: Lundey engine component diagram
description: The game itself, stepped sixty times a second, with no drawing, no sound and no page. One seeded generator digs every burrow and makes every random choice, so a seed and a set of controls always play out the same.

components.name: Lundey engine
components.responsibility: The game, with no drawing, no sound and no page.

components.name: Game (game.ts)
components.responsibility: The phases of a game, the puffin, the four hunters, the terns, treats, score and lives; step(input) moves everything on by one sixtieth of a second and collects the step's events.

components.name: Burrows (maze.ts)
components.responsibility: Digs a burrow from a seed (buildMaze), and answers how tiles join (neighbour, walkable) and how far apart they are along the tunnels (distances).

components.name: Rules (rules.ts)
components.responsibility: Every number the game plays by: the island's size, speeds, waits, how long things last and what they score, and how each changes from burrow to burrow.

components.name: Rng (rng.ts)
components.responsibility: mulberry32: the seeded generator behind every burrow and every random choice.

components.name: Autopilot (autopilot.ts)
components.responsibility: A simple player: heads for the nearest eel, feather or treat and shies from hunters that come close. Plays the demo and the tests.
